On an HDMI 2.0 connection G-SYNC shows Off and the refresh rate stays below the maximum: an ASUS VG279QM does 280 Hz only over DP, 240 Hz over HDMI. On a laptop use DisplayPort or a USB-C port with DP wired to the GPU.
